author: MrDogPT
body:
Hello! Me and my friend FlashFireK, we made a map named Lake TE.
It's an 5x5 - 7x7 map.  CTW
Album: http://imgur.com/a/khjXY
Green Team vs Red Team
Orange wool & Yellow Wool / Blue wool and purple Wool
Main Pic: 
http://imgur.com/a/G9Ke8
The XML is not done yet, but I will add regions in that space Middle-wool room ( and more )
If anyone could world with XML, contact me here or in skype: dudapt41
